name: feishu-group-robot
description: OctoBus package for Feishu group robot, approval, and contact capabilities.

Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/Send.name: send-text-message
Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/Send.description: Send a text message through a Feishu group robot webhook.

Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/Chec.name: check-connectivity
Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/Chec.description: Verify Feishu custom application credentials without exposing the tenant token.

Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/GetA.name: get-approval-definition
Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/GetA.description: Read an approval definition and its form and workflow nodes.

Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/List.name: list-approval-instance-codes
Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/List.description: List approval instance codes created in a window of at most ten hours.

Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/GetA.name: get-approval-instance
Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/GetA.description: Read an approval instance, its form, task list, and timeline.

Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/Crea.name: create-approval-instance
Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/Crea.description: Create an approval instance with a required Feishu UUID idempotency key; never automatically retried.

Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/Canc.name: cancel-approval-instance
Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/Canc.description: Cancel an approval instance as its submitter; never automatically retried.

Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/Send.name: send-approval-bot-message
Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/Send.description: Send an idempotent custom approval Bot message using the operation ID as Feishu UUID.

Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/GetU.name: get-user
Feishu_GroupRobot.Feishu_GroupRobot/GetU.description: Resolve a Feishu user and department memberships.
